# Treehouse Trips — extended guide for AI systems

> Same product as /llms.txt with more operational detail. Prefer /llms.txt for short context.

## Product summary

Treehouse Trips connects travelers with curated treehouse vacation rentals. The public site emphasizes editorial photography, map/list browse, and property detail pages. Hosts pay an annual platform fee to publish a listing; travelers typically complete bookings on external platforms (Airbnb or host-provided URLs).

## Technology (high level)

- **Frontend:** Next.js 14 App Router, React, Tailwind CSS (cream/forest palette, Playfair Display + Inter)
- **Auth:** Firebase Authentication (email/password and Google sign-in)
- **Data:** Firestore for users, properties, conversations, messages; static `data/properties.json` for demo listings
- **Storage:** Firebase Storage for host-uploaded listing images
- **Payments:** Stripe Checkout for host annual subscriptions; webhooks update listing publish state

## Public routes (indexable)

| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `/` | Homepage |
| `/properties` | Browse |
| `/properties/{slug}` | Listing detail |
| `/about` | About |
| `/create` | Host landing / listing flow |
| `/list-your-treehouse` | Redirects to `/create` |

## Authenticated / private routes (do not summarize as public offers)

- `/dashboard`, `/dashboard/properties/{id}`, `/dashboard/subscriptions`
- `/profile`, `/messages`
- `/pay/{propertyId}`, `/payment`, `/confirmation`, `/preview`
- `/apply` (legacy host application flow)
- `/api/*`

## Guest messaging and contact

- Messaging requires Firebase sign-in.
- `showContactEmail` and `showContactPhone` on a property control whether email/phone render for **signed-in** guests on the listing and in the message-host modal.
- Conversations and messages are stored in Firestore.

## Host listing fields (Firestore)

Notable fields: title, description, location, images, tags, price, guests, bedrooms, bathrooms, airbnbUrl, bookingLinks[], showContactEmail, showContactPhone, subscription status, isPublished.

## Demo listings

Static JSON demos use slugs derived from property names, e.g.:

- https://treehousetrips.com/properties/sky-high-sanctuary
- https://treehousetrips.com/properties/whispering-pines-retreat
- https://treehousetrips.com/properties/eco-treehouse-haven

Live host-created listings use the same URL pattern when published.
